meta.source: Center for Threat-Informed Defense, mappings-explorer: MITRE ATT&CK v16.1 (Enterprise) to NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, 'mitigates' mappings
meta.semantics: A control mitigates a technique (mapping_type 'mitigates'). It is a threat-informed lookup, not a statement that this library checks the control.
meta.id_normalisation: Source capability ids are zero-padded (AC-02); keys here are unpadded (AC-2) to match crosswalk/stig_800_53. Enhancements would be AC-2(1); the source holds base controls only.
